interface.name: kestrel_glass_manager_v1

description.summary: the material of a surface's glass

interface.description:
Glass is the part of a surface a client asks to blur through ext_background_effect_v1. Kestrel draws it as one of two materials: Luca, a blur of what is behind the surface or only of the wallpaper, and Maris, the desktop's surface colour over a wide blur of the wallpaper that covers most of it.
Through a glass object, a client says what kind of surface the glass belongs to and which material it would like, and hears which material the glass has. A client draws its own tint over Luca glass, and none over Maris glass, whose surface colour is already the whole surface.

entry.name: glass_exists
entry.summary: the surface already has a glass object

request.name: destroy
request.description: Destroying the manager leaves glass objects it created intact.

request.name: get_glass

description.summary: get the glass object of a surface

interface.name: kestrel_glass_v1
interface.description: Requests take effect immediately and last until they are changed or the object is destroyed, which returns the surface to a window that follows the person's choice.

entry.name: window
entry.summary: the base of a window, such as its sidebar

entry.name: transient
entry.summary: a transient surface, such as a popover, a menu or a palette

entry.name: user
entry.summary: the material the person chose for this kind of surface

entry.name: luca
entry.summary: a blur of what is behind, or of the wallpaper only

entry.name: maris
entry.summary: the surface colour over a wide blur of the wallpaper

description.summary: return the surface to a window following the person

request.name: set_role

description.summary: say what kind of surface the glass belongs to

request.description: Windows follow the person's choice for app windows, transient surfaces their choice for panels and menus. The default is window.

request.name: set_preference
request.description: Maris is always granted. Luca is granted too, and then blurs only the wallpaper whenever the person's Luca glass does, such as while the power saver is on. The default is user.

event.name: material
event.description: Sent when the object is created and whenever the material changes.
